correctness.rationale: For Y=sum of largest r of m iid Poi(λ), Y=T=sum all Xi whenever Y<r, and at Y=r the only extra configurations have j≥r+1 unit-valued positives; hence q_k=e^(−mλ)(mλ)^k/k! for k<r, q_r adds e^(−mλ)Σ_{j=r+1}^m C(m,j)λ^j. Exact cancellation of Poisson ULC equality gives defect −r e^(−2mλ)(mλ)^(r−2)/(r−2)! times B_{m,r}(λ)<0 for 2≤r<m. At r=m Poisson ULC; at r=1 known discrete order-statistics ULC preservation theorem covers maximum. Ordinary local LC has sign of m^r/[r!(r−1)]−Σ_{j>r}C(m,j)λ^(j−r), strictly decreasing giving a unique λ*. Scaling s=mλ, (m)_j/m^j grows strictly with m and dominated convergence gives the decreasing root to τ_r. Independently recomputed m=3,r=2 coefficients 9/2 and 1, threshold 9/2 and exact deficit −2λ³e^(−6λ), and reviewed finite enumerator polynomial logic. All-parameter proof is symbolic/combinatorial, not finite test extrapolation.
